question: Which category has the highest average booking amount?
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname, ROUND(AVG(b.final_amount), 2) AS avg_booking_amt FROM categories c JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.category_id = c.id JOIN bookings b ON b.shop_id = sd.id GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname ORDER BY avg_booking_amt DESC LIMIT 1;
